lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 004: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-004 fixed devcontainer.json: added workspaceMount (source=${localWorkspaceFolder},target=/workspace,type=bind) and workspaceFolder (/workspace). Without these, devcontainer mounts at /workspaces/cam-cli by default, so postStartCommand path /workspace/.devcontainer/init-firewall.sh (and the sudoers rule in Dockerfile) would not resolve. Check prd.json for any remaining passes:false stories.
